title: TPLF Says It Temporarily Left Mekelle as Federal Forces and Allied Militia Take City
detail: Al Jazeera reports federal forces and allied Tigray Peace Force fighters took Mekelle after the TPLF withdrew, which the TPLF called tactical and temporary; it says it will keep fighting from other locations. Fighting has spread to Afar and Amhara as part of a wider armed-opposition alliance. Eritrea and Ethiopia severed relations Thursday. Independent verification of the ground situation remains limited.
